title: Vampire Vape Vanilla Cappuccino Tobacco Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Vampire Vape Vanilla Cappuccino Tobacco Concentrate offers a layered mix of Tobacco, smooth Vanilla and rich Cappuccino for DIY e-liquid creation. The Tobacco base brings earthy depth, Vanilla softens with mellow sweetness, and Cappuccino introduces a roasted coffee edge. This 30ml flavour concentrate must be diluted before use and is designed for experienced mixers who want to build their own e-liquids. It provides complete flexibility over VG/PG ratios and nicotine content, making it ideal for custom recipes. Produced in the UK, Vampire Vape concentrates are valued by DIY vapers for their flavour quality and consistency.
